# CANDIDATE: TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Using the trendline break signal as a call veto (blocking call entries when bearish structure is confirmed) will avoid the call loser trades on 5/07 without affecting the put winner trades, thereby increasing edge_capture by approximately $165. The signal fires before J's 11:15+ counter-trend call entries on 5/07, providing timely structural confirmation.

## Mechanism

The trendline_break_call_veto detector fires on a 5m-close-through-respected-ascending-support (bearish structure confirmed). When enabled as a call veto, it blocks call entries on the same bar. The detector does not evaluate or affect put entries. Entry suppression occurs at the bar open following the signal bar.
